Title: Tanay and the Family

Cast

1. Tanay - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anjali - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Sharda - 69 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
4. Isha - 12 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
5. Ishaan - 12 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Sharda stand near him.]

Tanay: "Today feels like a good day."

[Tanay claps his hands.]

Tanay (happily): "One more time!"

[Tanay hugs Mother tightly.]

Tanay: "One more time!"

[Tanay nods.]

Tanay (excited): "And then?"

[Tanay thinks for a moment.]

Anjali: "I'm ready!"

[Tanay takes the bag from Mother.]

Tanay: "Really?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Tanay: "What a nice place."

[Tanay munches on an apple.]

Tanay (excited): "Careful!"

[Tanay gulps down a glass of milk.]

Tanay: "Mom, listen!"

[Tanay does his homework at the table.]

Tanay: "What happened?"

[Tanay slams the door shut.]

Tanay (surprised): "Show me too!"

[Tanay opens the window.]

Tanay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
